en: The hottest time of day is usually around 3 PM because Earth's surface needs hours to absorb sunlight and warm the air above it.
Weather describes day-to-day atmospheric conditions while climate measures average weather patterns in a region over at least 30 years.
Healthy soil is made of weathered rock particles, decomposed organic matter called humus, water, and trapped air.
A true mineral must have a specific crystal structure and chemical formula, which is why obsidian glass is not a mineral.
Water vapor is a completely invisible gas; clouds only appear when that vapor cools and condenses into visible liquid water droplets.
The sun generates energy through nuclear fusion, smashing hydrogen atoms into helium, not through chemical combustion like a campfire.
Polaris is only the 48th brightest star in the night sky; the brightest star visible from Earth is Sirius.
The moon has no light of its own and shines only by reflecting sunlight off its rocky surface.
Earthquakes happen when stress builds up along cracks called faults in tectonic plates and is suddenly released as seismic waves.
Venus is hotter than Mercury despite being farther from the sun because its thick carbon dioxide atmosphere traps heat intensely.
Molten rock is called magma while it stays underground and is renamed lava only after it erupts onto Earth's surface.
The moon rotates on its axis once every 27.3 days, matching its orbital period, which is why we always see the same face.
